cases.name: slash-how-do-i
cases.ask: How do I use /theme to turn on dark mode?

trials.text: /theme dark turns it on — the command takes the word for the mode, so /theme dark sets dark mode and /theme light switches back. I left your theme untouched.

/web opens an outside web page for you. By default it embeds the page in the chat with the site's origin shown above it; if the site refuses embedding, you get a card with an Open in new tab button instead.
